digest.component_or_area: Jira rich-text reconciler (Cloud ADF + Data Center wiki)
propositions: Cloud descriptions and comments must encode Markdown as structured ADF rather than plain-text paragraphs through the production codec path

Data Center descriptions and comments must render Markdown as native Jira wiki markup through a segmenting Markdown-to-wiki renderer backed by pandoc, with safe units converted and dangerous units passed verbatim
Echo-safety layer using per-binding baselines, change-gated rich_sha, and last-write-wins three-way comparison must suppress unchanged second-pass commits and flag concurrent edits without data loss
Jira-native constructs (panels, mentions, dates) must survive round-trip reconciliation through origin-gated outbound normalization that preserves non-Markdown markers
Comment sync must be append-only with persistent local-comment-key to Jira-comment-ID mapping and codec-routed comment creation matching the description path
Live Docker-based Jira DC harness must verify rendered HTML through expand=renderedFields and confirm no body update on second reconcile pass
